INFRABENCH LOGO KIT
===================

One object, three renderings: STAMPED, DRAWN, BUILT.

DRAWN, the primary mark. infrabench-glyph.svg is a technical
drawing: outline envelope, seated block, 10 of 14 grid units, the
derate the Rack Budget defaults produce (30 MW at PUE 1.2 with a
15 percent margin keeps 71 percent of nameplate). The empty units
sit at the top, where an unpopulated U sits in a real rack face.
This is the rendering the site header, favicons and README use.
The suite family in glyph/family/ shares this grammar
(rack-budget, crash-cart, power-map, outage-replay).

STAMPED, the heavyweight rendering. infrabench-glyph-solid.svg is
one path: the same envelope as a solid block with the derate carved
out below the rim. 207 bytes, single color, best where mass helps:
avatars, stickers, etching, embroidery.

BUILT, the hero mark. hero/ holds the isometric rack cell in the
Rack Budget hall's own projection and paint: the spec as a glass
wireframe above the solid rack. Use it large: og images, social
cards, README headers.

SPECIAL LOCKUPS
  glyph/infrabench-logo-solid.svg      primary lockup, dark
  glyph/infrabench-logo-solid-light.svg  light backgrounds
  glyph/infrabench-logo-terminal.svg   INFRABENCH with the mark as a
                                       trailing cursor, at the site's
                                       own .5em cursor proportion
  glyph/infrabench-logo-terminal-blink.svg  same, cursor blinks with
                                       the site's 1.1s steps(1) timing
  glyph/infrabench-glyph-kinetic.svg   animated: starts as the perfect
                                       spec-sheet square, then the slot
                                       drops open to 71 percent. SMIL,
                                       no scripts, transparent safe,
                                       6 second loop. Use where motion
                                       is welcome; the static glyph is
                                       the accessible default.

FAVICONS
  glyph/favicon.svg          solid mark, pixel hinted 16 grid; render
                             at 16, 32, 48, 64
  glyph/favicon-outline.svg  drawn mark, same hinting
  hero/favicon-iso.svg       isometric, for larger tiles

png/ holds raster exports of everything.

The wordmark is JetBrains Mono converted to outlines (700 for the
name, 500 for the tagline). JetBrains Mono is copyright The JetBrains
Mono Project Authors, SIL Open Font License 1.1, which permits
embedding outlined glyphs in a logo. All colors are the site's own
CSS variables. No file references a font, script or external
resource.
